convert_kilt_json: convert a KILT-format JSON input file to a simplified QA format with questions, answers, and context passages
run_convert_kilt_cli: run the preprocess script as a CLI tool to convert KILT JSON data from input to output path
extract_answers_from_kilt: extract unique answers from KILT output entries and store them as a deduplicated list
extract_provenance_passages: extract provenance passages with text, wikipedia title, and wikipedia id from KILT output data
review_convert_kilt: review the convert_kilt function to understand how it transforms KILT input format into a simplified QA structure
